title: 2508: Co-located markers don't show as selected

review_comments_data.body: @lebaphi - doesn't the above code mean that assets could get put into the `raw` _and_ the `clustered` lists?  That would mean they were rendered twice.

issues.title: Co-located markers don't show as selected
issues.body:
When a marker is `selected`, we don't cluster it.

But, when markers are co-located, we do cluster them, to prevent them stacking.

This means we do see co-located selected assets.

We need to modify `planning-force` to make clusters pulse if they contain one or more selected assets.

In `planning-force`, this function generates cluster icons: `iconCreateFunction`.  It receives a set of markers.  So, we need to `inject` some field into a marker to show if they are selected.  We then need to check the set of markers in the above method, and decide if any are currently selected.  If they are - then we add styling to the marker cluster to make it pulse.

To test this we need data at exactly the same location. I'll investigate this.
